raw.query: SELECT run_id, signal, metric_path, value_num FROM provenance.eda_metric WHERE metric_path ILIKE '%hill_tail_index%'
raw.claimed: Generated tokens have the heaviest tail among the three request-level marginals (Hill estimate).
raw.evidence: GeneratedTokens has the smallest Hill tail index (1.938), which mathematically corresponds to the heaviest tail among the three request-level marginals (lower index = heavier tail).
